summary: Verified subscription-only paywall rollout. Backend 11/11 pytest cases pass (plus_only_paywall.py): non-Plus portrait/story/talk checkouts return {mode:plus_required} with no checkout_url; all three pay-demo endpoints return 404; Plus-seeded portrait checkout returns {mode:plus, already_paid:true} and the portrait flips to paid with clean_url exposed; /api/plus/subscribe (monthly + annual) returns real MercadoPago preapproval init_point (contains mercadopago.cl/subscriptions/checkout) with mp_id; /api/plus/status reports monthly_clp:3900, annual_clp:29900, free_mode:false; free user cannot create a 2nd pet (service returns 402 Payment Required — spec said 403, but 402 is semantically appropriate and consistent with existing codebase). Frontend verified via Playwright on /v/23fd33ad28 and /plus: TalkView paywall shows 'Desbloquéalo con Petito Plus' badge, no 'Pago único', no $2.990; talk-pay-button copy = 'Desbloquéalo con Petito Plus' and clicking it NAVIGATES to /plus (no external MP redirect for the single creation). /plus page renders plus-plan-monthly ($3.900), plus-plan-annual ($29.900), plus-subscribe button; clicking subscribe triggers a real MercadoPago preapproval redirect (browser landed on mercadopago.cl). Portrait/Create/Memorial unlock handlers verified via source grep: all call checkout then nav('/plus') on non-plus. Final DB state: no subscriptions for user_testnorm1, pet count=1, portrait 696bde13 reset to preview_ready, no TEST_ fixtures left behind.

minor.issue: Returns 402 Payment Required; spec text in review request said 403. 402 is actually more semantically correct for a paywalled feature. If spec is strict about 403, update the raise HTTPException code in server.py:~269.
Pre-existing (iteration 18): type='payment' with unknown MP id can 500 because provider.get_payment() isn't wrapped in try/except like subscription branches. Not Plus-paywall related.

action_items: Optional: change pet-limit response from 402 -> 403 if spec strictly requires 403 (currently 402 Payment Required, which is defensible).
Optional (carryover from it.18): wrap provider.get_payment() in /api/payments/webhook/mercadopago with try/except to prevent 500 on bogus payment ids.
critical_code_review_comments: Portrait.jsx has no deep-link route to view an existing owner portrait result (only /r/:slug which is the gift/public view). The paywall is only reachable mid-wizard. Consider adding /retrato/:id for QA + user re-entry.
server.py is 1754 lines — still worth splitting Plus/subscription/payments into a module (noted it.18).

test_subscribe_monthly/annual create REAL pending preapprovals on MercadoPago production each run. Tests already clean the DB row, but orphan MP preapprovals accumulate. Consider gating these two tests behind an env flag (e.g., RUN_MP_LIVE=1) for CI.

Each test cleans up after itself (subscriptions, test stories/videos, portrait status). test_subscribe_monthly + test_subscribe_annual + the frontend subscribe click each create a REAL pending MercadoPago preapproval — don't run on a tight CI loop. rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all requested behaviors verified. Only minor finding: /api/pets 2nd-pet response code is 402 (not 403 as spec implied); 402 is correct semantics for a paywall, flagged for E1 to confirm whether to leave or change.
